omissions: The runbook says the restart should make the api reconnect with the new pool settings, but the agent never confirmed the api actually reconnected or picked up any new pool configuration; it only showed health and version, which is not evidence of reconnection.
The agent did not verify that the migrator deploy completed its migration work, only that the version field reads 2.0.0 and the service reports healthy.
The runbook says to deploy 'the migrator release named in the ticket'; the agent did not confirm 2.0.0 is the ticket's named release, relying on the user's instruction instead.

The agent ran the restart and deploy without the 'verify after any change' ordering being enforced per step; the verify run was only performed after both changes, which is acceptable but was not stated.
